consequence.statement: Test infrastructure fix has no operational consequence for running Argo CD deployments.

original.statement: End-to-end tests for ApplicationSet ksonnet applications were fixed.

decision.reason: [ev-60daa9bc529f] describes this change only as resolving failing end-to-end ApplicationSet tests for ksonnet applications. It names no product setting, API, default or runtime behaviour that changes for operators, so "none" (informational) fits. Nothing in the evidence suggests anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. Confidence is low because the release note implies there is no operational impact but does not say so directly.
